policy_statement: Reduce Armenia's greenhouse gas emissions by 40% below 1990 levels by 2030 under the 2021-2030 NDC.
source_quote: Thus, The Republic of Armenia ratified the Paris Agreement in 2017, and on April 22, 2021 the Government of Armenia approved Armenia's Nationally Determined Contributions for a ten-year implementation period (2021-2030), setting the new unconditional mitigation target of 40 per cent reduction below 1990 emissions levels, to be achieved in 2030.
extraction_rationale: Quantified national GHG target with deadline.

policy_statement: Raise Lake Sevan's water level by 6.5 meters over 30 years to provide additional strategic water reserves.
source_quote: It is planned to raise the level of Lake Sevan by 6.5 m within a period of 30 years. This will provide additional water reserves, which will serve as a highly important and strategically significant natural resource for energy and other economic sectors 5 .
extraction_rationale: Quantified water-resource intervention; climate link is resilience-related but indirect.

policy_statement: Implement Forest Sector reforms, strategy and action plan for sustainable forest management, climate-impact reduction, increased forest cover and improved species composition.
source_quote: On November 30, 2017, the Government of the RA approved the concept of reforms, strategy and action plan for Forest Sector. The reforms aimed at the establishment of a sustainable forest management system to develop and implement state unified policy in the field of preservation, protection, reproduction and use of the forests in Armenia, elimination or mitigation of the negative impact of climate change on the sustainability of forest ecosystems, increase of forest covered areas and improving the species composition,
extraction_rationale: Government-approved forest strategy/action plan explicitly addressing climate impacts.

policy_statement: Increase solar energy generation to at least 15% or 1.8 billion kWh by 2030 through construction of about 1000 MW of solar plants.
source_quote: The RA Government has intended to increase the share of solar energy generation in total to at least 15% or 1.8 billion kWh by 2030. To this end, solar power plants with the capacity of about 1000 MW, including autonomous ones, are planned to be constructed 35 .
extraction_rationale: Quantified renewable-energy target with deadline.

policy_statement: Implement the National Renewable Energy Action Plan to achieve 5% renewable energy capacity by 2025 and 10% by 2035.
source_quote: NREAP has two primary targets: having 5% of energy (255 MW of installed capacity) from renewable sources by 2025, and 10% (710 MW of installed capacity) by 2035 (SEU, 2017a). The plan seeks to realize these targets by a mixture of solar, wind, and waste-toenergy technologies and involves a mixture of public and private investment. When fully implemented, it is expected to avoid about 392,000 tonnes of CO 2 per year.
extraction_rationale: Official national action plan with quantified renewable energy targets and sub-policies.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Enable consumers to generate on-site, grid-connected renewable energy through net metering.
source_quote: Three main policies have been established to realize the targets, as follows: - Net metering: This will enable consumers to generate on-site, grid-connected, renewable energy, for example via the installation of solar panels on roofs; - Feed-in tariffs: This is a tender-based mechanism to support renewable energy characterized by long-term power purchase agreements; and - Mandates: This refers to renewable energy mandates for new buildings.
extraction_rationale: Net metering is a specific established renewable energy policy instrument.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Use tender-based feed-in tariffs with long-term power purchase agreements to support renewable energy.
source_quote: Three main policies have been established to realize the targets, as follows: - Net metering: This will enable consumers to generate on-site, grid-connected, renewable energy, for example via the installation of solar panels on roofs; - Feed-in tariffs: This is a tender-based mechanism to support renewable energy characterized by long-term power purchase agreements; and - Mandates: This refers to renewable energy mandates for new buildings.
extraction_rationale: Feed-in tariffs are a specific financial and procurement mechanism supporting renewable energy.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Apply renewable energy mandates for new buildings.
source_quote: Three main policies have been established to realize the targets, as follows: - Net metering: This will enable consumers to generate on-site, grid-connected, renewable energy, for example via the installation of solar panels on roofs; - Feed-in tariffs: This is a tender-based mechanism to support renewable energy characterized by long-term power purchase agreements; and - Mandates: This refers to renewable energy mandates for new buildings.
extraction_rationale: Renewable energy mandates for new buildings are a binding regulatory mechanism under NREAP.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Deploy solar PV through decentralized applications and large-scale installations, reaching about 300 MW by 2030.
source_quote: Solar PV systems will be deployed as decentralized renewable energy applications in urban areas as well as large-scale installations on available land. Decentralized applications include the following: - Solar systems for new housing units; - Solar systems for government buildings; - Decentralized solar in urban developments (solar lighting, solar parking); and - Decentralized rooftop solar on existing residential and commercial buildings. By 2030, projected capacity totals 300 MW, generating about 510 GWh.
extraction_rationale: Named renewable energy deployment initiative with a quantified capacity estimate.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Deploy onshore wind systems primarily as large-scale installations on available land.
source_quote: Aside from some micro wind opportunities in urban areas, onshore wind systems will be mostly deployed as large-scale installations on available land. These opportunities on available land include the following: - Utility-scale wind farms by large industry groups; and - Wind farms on other available land.
extraction_rationale: Specific renewable energy deployment intervention under NREAP.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Deploy offshore wind farms and integrate renewable energy technologies in large infrastructure projects.
source_quote: Offshore wind systems will be mostly deployed as large-scale installations on available land. These opportunities on available land include the following: - Near shore or offshore wind farms; and - Integrating renewable energy technologies in large infrastructure projects (causeways and railway systems).
extraction_rationale: Specific renewable energy deployment intervention. OCR appears to contain an inconsistency saying offshore wind will be deployed on available land.

parent_statement: National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP)
policy_statement: Deploy biogas systems through landfill gas capture at Askar and a waste-to-energy plant at Tubli wastewater treatment plant.
source_quote: Biogas systems will be deployed as large-scale installations on available land. Opportunities include landfill gas capture at the Askar landfill site and a waste-to-energy plant at the Tubli wastewater treatment plant. By 2030, projected capacity totals 7.5 MW, generating about 20 GWh.
extraction_rationale: Named renewable energy and waste-to-energy deployment initiative with quantified capacity.

policy_statement: Implement the National Energy Efficiency Action Plan to reduce energy use by 6% by 2025.
source_quote: NEEAP is a complementary initiative (SEU, 2017b). After extensive consultations with stakeholders, the SEU established the target of a 6% reduction (about 6,000 GWh) in final energy consumption by 2025. It is estimated that this would lead to a cumulative reduction in greenhouse gas emissions of 3.4 million tonnes of CO 2 by 2025.
extraction_rationale: Official national energy efficiency action plan with quantified energy and GHG reduction targets and multiple sub-initiatives.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Adopt building energy efficiency codes with mandatory specifications for new buildings and renovations.
source_quote: Building energy efficiency codes: This initiative aims to reduce energy demand in buildings by putting in place comprehensive mandatory energy efficiency specifications for the construction of new buildings and renovation of existing buildings. Minimum energy performance standards and labeling for lighting, air conditioning, appliances: This initiative implements minimum energy performance standards (MEPS) for household and commercial lamps, small and large air conditioning units, and appliances.
extraction_rationale: Regulatory energy efficiency intervention with mandatory specifications.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Implement minimum energy performance standards and labeling for lighting, air conditioning units, and appliances.
source_quote: Minimum energy performance standards and labeling for lighting, air conditioning, appliances: This initiative implements minimum energy performance standards (MEPS) for household and commercial lamps, small and large air conditioning units, and appliances. It also makes energy performance an explicit part of the purchase decision through energy labeling.
extraction_rationale: MEPS and labeling are specific regulatory and informational efficiency instruments.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Use building energy labels to disclose energy performance and reduce building energy consumption.
source_quote: Building energy labeling: This initiative aims to reduce energy consumption in buildings through making energy performance of buildings explicit through the use of building energy labels. Green building certification: This initiative aims to promote the construction of more resourceefficient buildings by establishing a green building certification program.
extraction_rationale: Named intervention for reducing energy use through information disclosure.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Establish a green building certification program to promote resource-efficient buildings.
source_quote: Green building certification: This initiative aims to promote the construction of more resourceefficient buildings by establishing a green building certification program. District cooling: This initiative aims to revitalize and expand the existing capacity of district cooling in Bahrain, by establishing a regulatory framework.
extraction_rationale: Named program for resource-efficient construction.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)

extraction_rationale: Named efficient cooling technology and regulatory intervention.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Establish energy management systems for government buildings.
source_quote: Government Buildings Energy Management: This initiative aims to pursue energy efficiency on a continuous basis in government buildings by establishing an energy management system for government buildings. Government Buildings Lighting Replacement: This initiative aims to improve the energy efficiency of lighting in all government premises.
extraction_rationale: Named operational energy management intervention in public buildings.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Replace lighting in all government premises to improve lighting energy efficiency.
source_quote: Government Buildings Lighting Replacement: This initiative aims to improve the energy efficiency of lighting in all government premises. Street Lighting Refurbishment: This initiative aims to improve energy efficiency in street lighting through the replacement of existing high-pressure sodium lamps with LED lamps.
extraction_rationale: Specific technology intervention in government premises.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Replace high-pressure sodium streetlights with LED lamps.
source_quote: Street Lighting Refurbishment: This initiative aims to improve energy efficiency in street lighting through the replacement of existing high-pressure sodium lamps with LED lamps. Green Public Procurement: This initiative aims to improve energy efficiency in government operations through requiring all public institutions to give preference to energy efficient and sustainable products when purchasing products, equipment and services.
extraction_rationale: Named technology intervention for energy savings.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Require public institutions to prefer energy-efficient and sustainable products, equipment, and services in procurement.
source_quote: Green Public Procurement: This initiative aims to improve energy efficiency in government operations through requiring all public institutions to give preference to energy efficient and sustainable products when purchasing products, equipment and services. Figure 4-3 (top) summarizes projected target energy savings over the 2015-2030 period for the government sector.
extraction_rationale: Specific procurement requirement for energy efficiency.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Implement an Industry Program to achieve a 4% industrial energy efficiency improvement by 2020.
source_quote: Industry Program: This initiative aims to drive a 1% improvement in annual energy consumption to reach a 4% energy efficiency improvement by 2020. The Industry Program initiative has a three-fold purpose: to coordinate the energy efficiency activities of the major industry players and large energy consumers; to share best practice between the companies through workshops and other knowledge-sharing activities; and to facilitate the collection of energy saving data between the companies and SEU.
extraction_rationale: Named industrial energy efficiency program with a quantified target.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Improve electricity production combustion efficiency by 1% by 2025.
source_quote: Electricity Production Efficiency: This initiative aims for a 1% improvement by 2025 in combustion. It will accomplish this through a number of complementary measures including reducing reliance on least efficient plants; using aggregated demand reduction/response as an alternative to new capacity; using demand side frequency response as an alternative to spinning reserve; and using real-time tariffs to better utilize existing capacity.
extraction_rationale: Power-sector efficiency initiative with a quantified target.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Improve electricity transmission and distribution efficiency and reduce system losses from 9.8%.
source_quote: Electricity T&D Efficiency: This initiative aims to improve the efficiency of the electricity delivery system and reduce current system losses of 9.8%. It will involve conducting dynamic line rating trials; using capacity banks and battery storage to better manage the system; and upgrading conductors, transformers and cables.
extraction_rationale: Named electricity grid efficiency intervention with specific technologies and a loss-reduction objective.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Improve the power factor to 0.9 or greater.
source_quote: Power Factor Correction: This initiative aims to improve the power factor to be 0.9 or greater. A low power factor can result in overall higher electricity consumption due to overheating of equipment; low efficiency of connected devices; and high voltage drops in alternators and transformers.
extraction_rationale: Named electricity efficiency measure with a quantified power-factor target.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Introduce smart meters for high electricity consumers and new developments.
source_quote: Smart Metering Program: This initiative aims to introduce smart meters to high electricity consumers and new developments. Smart meters record electricity use and communicates the information to the electricity supplier for monitoring. It promotes better ability to manage daytime consumption peaks and electricity consumption through the use of real-time pricing.
extraction_rationale: Named technology and demand-management intervention.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Reform transport fuel subsidies to reduce annual light-duty vehicle fuel use by 4%.
source_quote: Transport Subsidy Reform: This initiative aims for a 4% reduction in annual fuel use in the light duty vehicle fleet. It will accomplish this through modification to the retail price of gasoline and diesel fuel, a reform process that has been underway since 2016. The price of regular grade gasoline (91 Octane) is being increased by 42%, from US$ 0.21 to US$ 0.30, while the price of premium grade gasoline (95 Octane) is being increased by 60%, from US$ 0.26 to US$ 0.42.
extraction_rationale: Specific pricing intervention with a quantified fuel-use reduction target.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Set minimum fuel economy standards and fuel economy labels for light-duty vehicles.
source_quote: Vehicle Efficiency Standards & Labeling: This initiative aims to improve efficiency in the transport sector by setting minimum fuel economy standards for light duty vehicles; and by making vehicle fuel economy an explicit part of the purchase decision by ensuring that labels are appropriately displayed thereby increasing consumer awareness. The fuel economy labels for light duty vehicles were implemented on all new vehicles of model 2018.
extraction_rationale: Regulatory vehicle efficiency standard and consumer labeling intervention.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Increase electricity tariffs to reflect generation costs and reduce electricity use by 14%.
source_quote: Electricity Subsidy Reform: This initiative aims to gradually increase electricity tariffs to reflect the actual costs of power generation and promote more efficient electricity consumption. Electricity tariff reform has been underway since 2016. When the effects of these new tariffs are fully realized, they are projected to result in a 14% reduction in electricity use compared to the 2009 - 2013 baseline.
extraction_rationale: Electricity pricing reform with a quantified projected reduction.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Run information campaigns on reducing energy use and replacing energy-consuming equipment and appliances.
source_quote: Raising Awareness & Information Dissemination: This initiative aims to augment information campaigns that focus on ways to reduce energy use, including habits and behaviors that should be modified and energy-consuming equipment and appliances that should be replaced. Training for Market Actors: This initiative aims to build and increase capacity in the energy services market, including energy efficiency training, accreditation and certification programmes
extraction_rationale: Named behavior and information intervention supporting energy savings.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Build capacity in the energy services market through training, accreditation, and certification.
source_quote: Training for Market Actors: This initiative aims to build and increase capacity in the energy services market, including energy efficiency training, accreditation and certification programmes. Institutional Infrastructure: This initiative aims strengthen institutional capacity to implement the various initiatives for achieving the national energy efficiency target.
extraction_rationale: Specific enabling intervention for energy efficiency delivery.

parent_statement: National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP)
policy_statement: Strengthen institutional capacity, focused on the Sustainable Energy Unit/Center, to implement the national energy efficiency target.
source_quote: Institutional Infrastructure: This initiative aims strengthen institutional capacity to implement the various initiatives for achieving the national energy efficiency target. Its focus will be on the SEU as the designated agency to coordinate implementation of the NEEAP.
extraction_rationale: Specific institutional implementation measure tied to the quantified NEEAP target.

policy_statement: Use BAPCO's carbon recovery plan to find industrial applications for waste CO2 from oil extraction.
source_quote: Project-level initiatives: Two projects have been launched. The first is BAPCO's carbon recovery plan, which finds industrial applications for the waste CO 2 associated with its oil extraction activities. The other is a carbon dioxide recovery unit launched by Gulf Petrochemicals Industries Company (GPIC) in 2009, a first for a petrochemicals company in the Middle East.
extraction_rationale: Specific project-level GHG mitigation intervention involving CO2 recovery and utilization.

policy_statement: Operate GPIC's carbon dioxide recovery unit to recover CO2 from petrochemical operations.
source_quote: Project-level initiatives: Two projects have been launched. The first is BAPCO's carbon recovery plan, which finds industrial applications for the waste CO 2 associated with its oil extraction activities. The other is a carbon dioxide recovery unit launched by Gulf Petrochemicals Industries Company (GPIC) in 2009, a first for a petrochemicals company in the Middle East.
extraction_rationale: Named CO2 recovery project and direct mitigation intervention.

policy_statement: Establish an emissions reduction fund that purchases verified carbon emission reduction credits.
source_quote: Carbon emission credits: An emissions reduction fund could be established where emitters are granted credits for projects that reduce verifiable carbon emissions. When validated, the government would purchase these credits to encourage further reductions. These credits could be financed by the removal of electricity tariff subsidies.
extraction_rationale: Concrete recommended financial instrument for verified emissions reductions. Wording is conditional, so commitment strength is limited.

policy_statement: Mandate ISO50001 Energy Management certification for industrial processes with substantial carbon emissions.
source_quote: Industrial energy efficiency: ISO50001 Energy Management certification could be mandated to ensure that energy efficiency is addressed in industrial processes that lead to substantial carbon emissions. There are several high-level policy implications and recommendations that have emerged from the national GHG mitigation assessment.
extraction_rationale: Concrete recommended binding mechanism for industrial energy management and carbon mitigation. Wording is conditional.

policy_statement: Deploy more efficient combustion technologies under the National Air Quality Strategy, including combined cycle gas turbines and combined heat and power generation.
source_quote: Furthermore, there are numerous other initiatives planned or underway in Bahrain which have not yet been assessed relative to their GHG reduction potential. These include the National Air Quality Strategy which calls for deployment of more efficient combustion technologies, such as combined cycle gas turbines and combined heat and power generation; a carbon recovery plant by BAPCO in which CO 2 -rich waste stream gas would be used for industrial applications, and a carbon recovery project by GPIC in which CO 2 in the flue gases of a methanol plant would be captured (GoB, 2015).
extraction_rationale: Named planned/underway strategy with specific efficiency technologies and explicit GHG-reduction relevance.

policy_statement: Implement Tubli Bay mangrove adaptation strategies, including observation, ecosystem service valuation, and blue carbon inventory.
source_quote: There are several adaptation strategies that are under consideration to build resilience against climate change risks Tubli Bay mangrove, as outlined below: - Tubli Bay observatory: This aims to strengthen existing observation systems to better understand the ecological services provided by mangrove habitats in Tubli Bay. Activities include monitoring, species mapping, systematic documentation, and dissemination of collected information to policymakers.
extraction_rationale: Named set of adaptation strategies for mangrove resilience; wording says 'under consideration', so adoption status is uncertain.

parent_statement: Tubli Bay mangrove adaptation strategies
policy_statement: Strengthen the Tubli Bay observatory through monitoring, species mapping, documentation, and dissemination of mangrove information to policymakers.
source_quote: - Tubli Bay observatory: This aims to strengthen existing observation systems to better understand the ecological services provided by mangrove habitats in Tubli Bay. Activities include monitoring, species mapping, systematic documentation, and dissemination of collected information to policymakers.
extraction_rationale: Named ecosystem monitoring intervention supporting climate resilience of mangrove habitats.

parent_statement: Tubli Bay mangrove adaptation strategies
policy_statement: Introduce ecosystem services valuation for Tubli Bay mangrove market and non-market services to support financial planning frameworks.
source_quote: - Ecosystem services valuation: This aims to introduce economic valuation as a basis to account for the value of the market (i.e., tourism) and non-market (i.e., regulating, provisioning, supporting) services that, Tubli Bay mangrove habitats provide. It will leverage information developed by the Tubli Bay observatory and apply state-of-the art ecological valuation methods to in support of financial planning frameworks.
extraction_rationale: Named nature-based policy support intervention that values mangrove services for planning.

parent_statement: Tubli Bay mangrove adaptation strategies
policy_statement: Augment Bahrain's GHG tracking system with a Tubli Bay blue carbon inventory documenting carbon pools and fluxes.
source_quote: - Blue carbon inventory: This aims to augment Bahrain's existing GHG emission tracking system to estimate and document carbon pools/fluxes in Tubli Bay consistent with international methodological guidance. This will involve data sharing across institutions, database development, information management, documentation, and dissemination of the levels and rates of carbon pool storage.
extraction_rationale: Named blue-carbon accounting intervention tied to biological carbon storage in mangroves and the GHG tracking system.

policy_statement: Develop a sea level rise adaptation framework covering protection, accommodation, retreat, and avoidance strategies.
source_quote: Going forward, it is recommended that systematic adaptation planning efforts be organized within an adaptation framework that address strategies for protection, accommodation, retreat, and avoidance. In the near-term, the focus should be on the following elements, with the aim of increasing institutional capacity to incorporate sea level rise risks within development planning:
extraction_rationale: Recommended adaptation framework with specific sub-elements; framed as a recommendation.

parent_statement: Sea level rise adaptation framework
policy_statement: Use planning tools to set sea level rise policy, assess coastal hazards, model/manage coastal risk, and develop emergency preparedness strategies.
source_quote: Planning tools: Planning tools include activities of setting an overall policy to mitigate the effect of sea level rise. At minimum, it should incorporate assessment of coastal hazards, coastal risk modeling/management, and development of emergency preparedness strategies.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation planning intervention responding to sea level rise.

parent_statement: Sea level rise adaptation framework
policy_statement: Use regulatory tools such as coastline zoning offsets, adjusted building codes, and sea-level-rise screening in real estate permits.
source_quote: Regulatory tools: These include tools such as enacting land use regulations (e.g., zoning offsets from the coastline), adjusting building codes (e.g., increasing the distance from pavement to ground floor) and accounting for sea level rise in real estate development permits (e.g., identification of nobuild zones). Land use tools: These refer to tools in support of strategic adaptation and include such as land acquisition (i.e., purchase/transfer of development rights), reclamation (e.g., adding more restrictions on top of basic zoning requirements for certain highrisk areas), zoning (i.e., reclassifying highly vulnerable land for low risk uses) and subdivision regulation (e.g., minimum conservation requirements)
extraction_rationale: Named regulatory adaptation mechanisms for managing sea level rise risk.

parent_statement: Sea level rise adaptation framework
policy_statement: Use land acquisition, reclamation restrictions, zoning, and subdivision regulation to shift vulnerable coastal land toward lower-risk uses.
source_quote: Land use tools: These refer to tools in support of strategic adaptation and include such as land acquisition (i.e., purchase/transfer of development rights), reclamation (e.g., adding more restrictions on top of basic zoning requirements for certain highrisk areas), zoning (i.e., reclassifying highly vulnerable land for low risk uses) and subdivision regulation (e.g., minimum conservation requirements). Hard and soft structural tools: Structural tools include assessment frameworks by which to assess the optimality of coastal protection with either hard measures (e.g., dikes, breakwaters) or soft measures (e.g., mangrove plantations, beach nourishment).
